Customer email when an ACH payment comes back (Adyen chargeback).

div.p: The ACH payment of $0.00 made on 01/01/2026 toward invoice INV/0001your account was returned by your bank, so the payment did not go through. The reason your bank gave was: insufficient funds (R01).
As stated in the Terms of Service on our website, a chargeback fee of $20.00 applies to returned payments. We have waived it this time; it will apply to any further returned payment.

Because this is not the first returned payment on your account in the last 12 months, a chargeback fee of $20.00 has been added to your account (invoice INV/0002), as stated in the Terms of Service on our website.
Because of repeated returned payments, ACH bank payments are no longer available on your account. Please contact us to arrange payment.

a.style: background-color: #875A7B; padding: 8px 16px; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px;

div.p: Please check with your bank and send the payment at your earliest convenience. If you have any questions, please reply to this email or call us at +1 404-750-4162.
